meta.title: Mobilcab — from idea to cut list, straight from your browser
meta.description: Cloud-based furniture CAD that runs in your browser, on laptop, tablet or phone. Now: 3D design and cut lists. Nesting and CNC come later, by stage.

hero.title: From idea to cut list, straight from your browser.
hero.body: Mobilcab is a cloud-based CAD for furniture — works on laptop, tablet, or phone. No installs, no license servers. Now: 3D design and cut lists. Sheet nesting and CNC export come later, as we ship each stage.
hero.note: Founding Partner: join the waitlist now; discount on the Basic plan when we ship M2. Later subscribers pay list price.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Heavy CAD software installed on one single workshop computer
Expensive licenses for features you barely use
Hours lost manually building the cutlist for your CNC
No easy way to show a live design to a client on-site, from your phone

items.title: 100% browser-based
items.body: No install, no license server. Open it on any device — laptop, tablet, phone.

items.title: For workshops
items.body: Workshop language and a design flow for made-to-order furniture — not a general CAD you have to bend until a cabinet comes out.

items.title: Start free
items.body: Use the app with no subscription. If you want a discount on the Basic plan when we ship M2, join the Founding Partner waitlist — nothing to pay now.

items.title: Through to cut list
items.body: Parts lists for the workshop; nesting, labels and quotes as we ship each stage.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.offerDetail: Join free. At M2: discount on the Basic plan if you're on the list. After that: list price.
pricing.aiNote: The Basic plan = workshop tools, no CNC. AI and CNC come separately.
pricing.free: The app is free until we open payment.
pricing.cancel: Joining does not oblige you to pay.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, Mobilcab runs straight from your browser.

items.q: Does it work on a tablet?
items.a: Yes, it's built for laptop, tablet and phone.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
items.a: The cut list is the foundation; CNC export comes in a later roadmap stage.
